title: GoiBERT: Compact Vietnamese Language Models via Two-Stage Knowledge Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vietnamese pre-trained encoders have improved rapidly, but the strongest ones are large, multilingual-vocabulary models or depend on external word segmentation, which makes them costly to deploy. We present GoiBERT, a family of two compact Vietnamese encoders with 26M and 49M parameters that operate directly on raw text. GoiBERT learns from two complementary teachers. A same-tokenizer Vietnamese encoder first teaches general-purpose representations. A much larger teacher then provides task-level guidance through soft labels that are generated without ever labeling its own training data. Across eight benchmarks covering text classification, aspect-based sentiment analysis, natural language inference, and named entity recognition, GoiBERT-large achieves the highest average score among non-teacher models. translated_title: GoiBERT：通过两阶段知识蒸馏构建紧凑型越南语语言模型
translated_abstract: 越南语预训练编码器近年来发展迅速，但性能最强的模型要么是采用多语言词表的大型模型，要么依赖外部分词工具，导致部署成本高昂。我们提出了GoiBERT，这是一系列包含两个紧凑型越南语编码器的模型家族，参数量分别为2600万和4900万，可直接处理原始文本。GoiBERT从两个互补的教师模型中学习：首先由一个使用相同分词器的越南语编码器传授通用语言表示；随后由一个大得多的教师模型通过软标签提供任务级指导，且软标签的生成不会标注教师模型自身的训练数据。在涵盖文本分类、方面级情感分析、自然语言推理和命名实体识别的八项基准测试中，GoiBERT-large在非教师模型中取得了最高的平均分数，其参数量不到最强紧凑基线模型的一半，而吞吐量则是其两倍。GoiBERT-base保留了99%的……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: GoiBERT通过两阶段知识蒸馏（先从同分词器越南语编码器学习通用表示，再从大型教师模型获取软标签任务指导），构建了仅2600万和4900万参数、可直接处理原始文本的紧凑越南语编码器，在八项基准测试中以不到一半的参数量和两倍吞吐量取得非教师模型中的最高平均分数。
en_tdlr: GoiBERT introduces compact Vietnamese encoders (26M and 49M parameters) that process raw text directly via two-stage knowledge distillation from two complementary teachers, achieving the highest average score among non-teacher models across eight benchmarks with less than half the parameters and twice the throughput of the strongest compact baseline.
